text: That account explains everything, and leaves nothing unaccounted for. Yet the passage rewards a reader who attends to what is missing from it. Sarah appears nowhere in the chapter, and the book announces her death in the verse immediately following; the scene implies, though it never states, that something in the household did not survive the mountain. At the moment when a lesser story would linger, the narrator turns away; Abraham returns to the servants, and Isaac is not mentioned.
